summary: FC6550D 安检机是一款采用双视角检查系统的高端安检设备。它利用双能量两组射线源探测器及数字图像处理系统，从垂直和水平两个方向同步对物品进行检测，无需考虑被检物品的摆放摆放位置即可获得极其清晰鲜明的图像。相比传统 X 射线设备，它在检查效率、空间利用率及减少误报漏报方面具有显著优势。设备支持物质识别功能，能精准分辨有机物、无机物和混合物，并具备辅助自动识别爆炸物与毒品的功能，为机场、海关及重要交通枢纽提供全方位的安全保障。
summary_en: The FC6550D X-ray scanner features a high-end dual-view inspection system, utilizing dual-energy X-ray sources and digital image processing to scan items from both vertical and horizontal directions simultaneously. This allows for exceptionally clear and vivid imaging regardless of how items are placed on the conveyor. Compared to traditional single-view equipment, the FC6550D offers significant advantages in throughput efficiency, station space utilization, and the reduction of false alarms or missed detections. With advanced material discrimination capabilities to distinguish between organic, inorganic, and metallic substances, and assisted identification for explosives and narcotics, it provides comprehensive security for airports, customs, and critical transportation hubs.
key_application: 应用领域：FC6550D双源双视角安检机；双视角同步检测，无需考虑摆放位置。高清图像穿透力强，具备爆炸物/毒品辅助检查与AI智能判图功能。
key_application_en: Dual-view vertical/horizontal scanning for zero blind spots; high-throughput 270kg load capacity; assisted AI detection for explosives and narcotics; advanced material identification (organic/inorganic/mixed).
key_parameter_2: 穿透力: 底照视角/侧照视角 46mm 钢板

parameters.技术特点: 多能量 X 射线检查、物质识别 (有机/无机/混合)、AI 智能判图

parameters.报警功能: 爆炸物/毒品自动探测标记、可疑物品声光报警

parameters_en.Technical Features: Dual-energy scanning; Material ID; AI-assisted analysis
parameters_en.Alarm Functions: Auto detection for explosives/narcotics; Audio-visual alerts
parameters_en.Structure and Build: 304 stainless steel frame; anti-pinch protection; smart-energy mode

detail_html:
功能特点

  • 双视角全维扫描：通过水平与垂直双源互补成像，彻底解决重叠物品遮挡导致的视觉盲区问题。
  • 物质精分技术：根据原子序数精确渲染颜色（有机物橙色、无机物蓝色、混合物绿色），识别精准。
  • AI智能辅助决策：实时自动圈选并分类标注刀具、枪支、烟花爆竹等违禁品，大幅降低判图员工作强度。
  • 高性能并行传输：图像数据传输速率提升10-20倍，确保高清画面实时反馈，无卡顿干扰。
  • 极致环保节能：具备行李自动感应技术，无物时电机静止，配合含保护膜铅帘，防止铅粉泄露。
  • 坚固工业设计：选用304不锈钢及冷轧板机架，通过严苛的高低温与震动试验，确保1万小时无故障运行。
  • Figure 1 Dual-View X-Ray Scanner
detail_html_en:
Features

  • 360° Inspection Synergy: dual X-ray sources provide orthogonal views (top and side), allowing operators to see under and behind complex items.
  • Material Intelligence: utilizes dual-energy imaging to color-code materials by atomic composition—Organic (Orange), Inorganic (Blue), and Mixed (Green).
  • AI-Powered Analytics: autonomously detects and highlights prohibited items like bladed weapons and firearms with on-screen bounding boxes.
  • Lightning-Fast Throughput: utilizes parallel data transmission for HD imagery, capable of handling 270kg loads at 0.2m/s for non-stop checkpoint flow.
  • Sustainability & Safety: features smart-sense conveyor activation and lead-sealed curtains with protective coating for maximum user safety.
  • Mission Reliability: built on a 304 stainless steel chassis, engineered and tested to exceed 10,000 hours of continuous operation in extreme climates.
